name: The Gray King
summary:
Explore and uncover secrets, unraveling the intertwined fates of each character in this turn-based RPG.

In their quest for eternal life, King Henry IV and his Bishop Mabel shattered reality. This plunged the world into madness, where time and space lost all meaning. Now, creatures of the imagination come to life, and the dead return with a single purpose: to restore order.

"Fix your eyes on those who truly deserve it."

"Open your eyes, if they are closed."

"Become part of this germinating seed."

"Become the bird that flies to the end of the universe."
